name: Mixed Mango, Lemon & Karande Kai Pickle
description: Tender mango, tangy lemon and karande kai (Carissa) pickled together in traditional Udupi spices. Made without oil.
ingredients: Mango, lemon, karande kai, salt, red chilly powder, mustard, fenugreek, turmeric, asafoetida (hing), spices.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. Always use a dry spoon.
